note: Constants refitted once a year from all completed seasons (runbooks/annual-refit.md, tools/annual_refit.py), not by the weekly loop. yoy: expected change in per-game production from one season to the next by age in the new season ([age up to, factor], pipeline/build_db.py and backtest/backtest_core.py). env_k: game-environment log elasticities [per unit of implied-total change x, per spread point] (engine/engine.js via tools/ftlib.py engine_source, and the backtest). low_volume: season-total cut below which a player counts as low-volume for the efficiency shrink target ([stat, cut]) and the base opportunities (x low_target) at which the target reaches the league rate. faab: preseason-rank cut for 'on waivers', startable and waiver-level positional ranks for the FAAB breakout pool (build_db.py). Version 1 = the values hardcoded before Oct 12, 2026.
